title: 16.14. Kusalattika, Chagocchakaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Akusalaṁ saññojanaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… ganthaṁ …pe… oghaṁ …pe… yogaṁ …pe… nīvaraṇaṁ …pe… parāmāsaṁ. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe tīṇi …pe… avigate pañca. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
